sloka: अकृष्टपच्या पृथिवी सुसम्पन्ना महात्मनः ।स राज्यं तादृशं भुङ्क्ते स्फीतमद्भुतदर्शनम् ।। ७.८४.८ ॥
transliteration: akṛṣṭapacyā pṛthivī susampannā mahātmanaḥ ।sa rājyaṁ tādṛśaṁ bhuṅkte sphītamadbhutadarśanam ।। 7.84.8 ॥

translations.english: The earth, without cultivation, yielded abundant crops for that great-souled king, and he enjoyed such a prosperous and marvelous kingdom.
